100   PURPOSE
   101      Decode a attribute message and return a pointer to a memory struct
   102          with the decoded information
   103   USAGE
   104      void *H5O__attr_decode(f, mesg_flags, p)
   105          H5F_t    *f;            IN: pointer to the HDF5 file struct
   106          H5O_t    *open_oh;      IN: pointer to the object header
   107          unsigned mesg_flags;    IN: message flags to influence decoding
   108          unsigned *ioflags;      IN/OUT: flags for decoding
   109          size_t   p_size;        IN: size of buffer *p
   110          const uint8_t *p;       IN: the raw information buffer
   111   RETURNS
   112      Pointer to the new message in native order on success, NULL on failure
   113   DESCRIPTION
   114          This function decodes the "raw" disk form of a attribute message
   115      into a struct in memory native format.  The struct is allocated within this
   116      function using malloc() and is returned to the caller.
   117  --------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   118  static void *
   119  H5O__attr_decode(H5F_t *f, H5O_t *open_oh, unsigned H5_ATTR_UNUSED mesg_flags, unsigned *ioflags,
   120                   size_t p_size, const uint8_t *p)
   121  {
   122      H5A_t        *attr = NULL;
   123      H5S_extent_t *extent;           /*extent dimensionality information  */
   124      size_t        name_len;         /*attribute name length */
   125      size_t        dt_size;          /* Datatype size */
   126      hssize_t      sds_size;         /* Signed Dataspace size */
   127      hsize_t       ds_size;          /* Dataspace size */
   128      unsigned      flags     = 0;    /* Attribute flags */
   129      H5A_t        *ret_value = NULL; /* Return value */
   130
   131      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   132
   133      /* check args */
   134      HDassert(f);
   135      HDassert(p);
   136
   137      if (NULL == (attr = H5FL_CALLOC(H5A_t)))
   138          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   139
   140      if (NULL == (attr->shared = H5FL_CALLOC(H5A_shared_t)))
   141          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "can't allocate shared attr structure")
   142
   143      /* Version number */
   144      attr->shared->version = *p++;
   145      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_1 || attr->shared->version > H5O_ATTR_VERSION_LATEST)
   146          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTLOAD, NULL, "bad version number for attribute message")
   147
   148      /* Get the flags byte if we have a later version of the attribute */
   149      if (attr->shared->version >= H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   150          flags = *p++;
   151
   152          /* Check for unknown flag */
   153          if (flags & (unsigned)~H5O_ATTR_FLAG_ALL)
   154              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTLOAD, NULL, "unknown flag for attribute message")
   155      } /* end if */
   156      else
   157          p++; /* Byte is unused when version<2 */
   158
   159      /*
   160       * Decode the sizes of the parts of the attribute.  The sizes stored in
   161       * the file are exact but the parts are aligned on 8-byte boundaries.
   162       */
   163      UINT16DECODE(p, name_len); /*including null*/
   164      UINT16DECODE(p, attr->shared->dt_size);
   165      UINT16DECODE(p, attr->shared->ds_size);
   166
   167      /*
   168       * Decode the character encoding for the name for versions 3 or later,
   169       * as well as some reserved bytes.
   170       */
   171      if (attr->shared->version >= H5O_ATTR_VERSION_3)
   172          attr->shared->encoding = (H5T_cset_t)*p++;
   173
   174      /* Decode and store the name */
   175      if (NULL == (attr->shared->name = H5MM_strdup((const char *)p)))
   176          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   177
   178      /* Make an attempt to detect corrupted name or name length - HDFFV-10588 */
   179      if (name_len != (HDstrlen(attr->shared->name) + 1))
   180          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTDECODE, NULL, "attribute name has different length than stored length")
   181
   182      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2)
   183          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_len); /* advance the memory pointer */
   184      else
   185          p += name_len; /* advance the memory pointer */
   186
   187      /* Decode the attribute's datatype */
   188      if (NULL == (attr->shared->dt = (H5T_t *)(H5O_MSG_DTYPE->decode)(
   189                       f, open_oh, ((flags & H5O_ATTR_FLAG_TYPE_SHARED) ? H5O_MSG_FLAG_SHARED : 0), ioflags,
   190                       attr->shared->dt_size, p)))
   191          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTDECODE, NULL, "can't decode attribute datatype")
   192      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2)
   193          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->dt_size);
   194      else
   195          p += attr->shared->dt_size;
   196
   197      /* decode the attribute dataspace.  It can be shared in versions >= 3
   198       * What's actually shared, though, is only the extent.
   199       */
   200      if (NULL == (attr->shared->ds = H5FL_CALLOC(H5S_t)))
   201          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   202
   203      /* Decode attribute's dataspace extent */
   204      if ((extent = (H5S_extent_t *)(H5O_MSG_SDSPACE->decode)(
   205               f, open_oh, ((flags & H5O_ATTR_FLAG_SPACE_SHARED) ? H5O_MSG_FLAG_SHARED : 0), ioflags,
   206               attr->shared->ds_size, p)) == NULL)
   207          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTDECODE, NULL, "can't decode attribute dataspace")
   208
   209      /* Copy the extent information to the dataspace */
   210      H5MM_memcpy(&(attr->shared->ds->extent), extent, sizeof(H5S_extent_t));
   211
   212      /* Release temporary extent information */
   213      extent = H5FL_FREE(H5S_extent_t, extent);
   214
   215      /* Default to entire dataspace being selected */
   216      if (H5S_select_all(attr->shared->ds, FALSE) < 0)
   217          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_DATASPACE, H5E_CANTSET, NULL, "unable to set all selection")
   218
   219      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2)
   220          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->ds_size);
   221      else
   222          p += attr->shared->ds_size;
   223
   224      /* Get the datatype's size */
   225      if (0 == (dt_size = H5T_get_size(attr->shared->dt)))
   226          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get datatype size")
   227
   228      /* Get the datatype & dataspace sizes */
   229      if (0 == (dt_size = H5T_get_size(attr->shared->dt)))
   230          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get datatype size")
   231      if ((sds_size = H5S_GET_EXTENT_NPOINTS(attr->shared->ds)) < 0)
   232          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get dataspace size")
   233      ds_size = (hsize_t)sds_size;
   234
   235      /* Compute the size of the data */
   236      H5_CHECKED_ASSIGN(attr->shared->data_size, size_t, ds_size * (hsize_t)dt_size, hsize_t);
   237
   238      /* Go get the data */
   239      if (attr->shared->data_size) {
   240          /* Ensure that data size doesn't exceed buffer size, in case of
   241             it's being corrupted in the file */
   242          if (attr->shared->data_size > p_size)
   243              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_OVERFLOW, NULL, "data size exceeds buffer size")
   244
   245          if (NULL == (attr->shared->data = H5FL_BLK_MALLOC(attr_buf, attr->shared->data_size)))
   246              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   247          H5MM_memcpy(attr->shared->data, p, attr->shared->data_size);
   248      } /* end if */
   249
   250      /* Increment the reference count for this object header message in cache(compact
   251         storage) or for the object from dense storage. */
   252      attr->shared->nrefs++;
   253
   254      /* Set return value */
   255      ret_value = attr;
   256
   257  done:
   258      if (NULL == ret_value)
   259          if (attr) {
   260              /* Free any dynamically allocated items */
   261              if (attr->shared)
   262                  if (H5A__shared_free(attr) < 0)
   263                      HDONE_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTRELEASE, NULL, "can't release attribute info")
   264
   265              attr = H5FL_FREE(H5A_t, attr);
   266          } /* end if */
   267
   268      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   269  } /* end H5O__attr_decode() */

   272   NAME
   273      H5O__attr_encode
   274   PURPOSE
   275      Encode a simple attribute message
   276   USAGE
   277      herr_t H5O__attr_encode(f, p, mesg)
   278          H5F_t *f;         IN: pointer to the HDF5 file struct
   279          const uint8 *p;         IN: the raw information buffer
   280          const void *mesg;       IN: Pointer to the simple datatype struct
   520   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   521   */
   522  H5A_t *
   523  H5A__open(const H5G_loc_t *loc, const char *attr_name)
   524  {
   525      H5A_t *attr      = NULL; /* Attribute from object header */
   526      H5A_t *ret_value = NULL; /* Return value */
   527
   528      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   529
   530      /* check args */
   531      HDassert(loc);
   532      HDassert(attr_name);
   533
   534      /* Read in attribute from object header */
   535      if (NULL == (attr = H5O__attr_open_by_name(loc->oloc, attr_name)))
   536          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTOPENOBJ, NULL,
   537                      "unable to load attribute info from object header for attribute: '%s'", attr_name)
   538
   539      /* Finish initializing attribute */
   540      if (H5A__open_common(loc, attr) < 0)
   541          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTINIT, NULL, "unable to initialize attribute")
   542
   543      /* Set return value */
   544      ret_value = attr;
   545
   546  done:
   547      /* Cleanup on failure */
   548      if (ret_value == NULL)
   549          if (attr && H5A__close(attr) < 0)
   550              HDONE_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTFREE, NULL, "can't close attribute")
   551
   552      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   553  } /* H5A__open() */
